Recipe.name: Chai-Spiced Apple Oat Pancakes
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat flat-top griddle to 350 F. 2. In bowl, combine all ingredients. Add pancake mix. Whisk until just blended. Batter will be slightly lumpy. DO NOT OVERMIX. 3. Coat hot griddle with cooking spray. 4. On griddle, pour 2-oz ladles batter 3" apart. 5. Cook until top of pancakes are covered with bubbles and edges begin to dry, 1 to 2 minutes. Turn pancakes over. Cook until golden brown, 1 to 2 minutes. 6. Serve immediately or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Apple Cinnamon Pancake
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Combine flour, sugar, brown sugar, baking powder, ground cinnamon, and salt. Whisk until well blended. 2. Combine milk, sliced apple, egg, margarine and lemon juice. Whisk until well blended. 3. Preheat flat-top griddle to 350 F. 4. Add dry ingredients all at once to wet ingredients. Whisk until just blended. Batter will be slightly lumpy. DO NOT OVERMIX. 5. Coat hot griddle with cooking spray. 6. On griddle, pour 2-oz ladles batter 3" apart 7. Cook until top of pancakes are covered with bubbles and edges begin to dry, 2 to 3 minutes. 8. Turn pancakes over. Cook until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes. 9. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Chocolate Chip Buttermilk Pancakes
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat flat-top griddle to 350 F. 2. In bowl, place water. Add pancake mix. Whisk until just blended. Batter will be slightly lumpy. DO NOT OVERMIX. 3.
